SHOUJOKAGEKIJUNNA-KNOWLEDGE.title: Knowledge
SHOUJOKAGEKIJUNNA-KNOWLEDGE.description: When you obtain this card, also obtain its other related Knowledge cards.
SHOUJOKAGEKIJUNNA-CHAIN_KNOWLEDGE.title: Chain Knowledge
SHOUJOKAGEKIJUNNA-CHAIN_KNOWLEDGE.descri: When you obtain Chain Knowledge, also obtain the other cards on the same selection screen and make them related cards. In combat, they go to the same pile and stay related until combat ends.
SHOUJOKAGEKIJUNNA-ARROW.title: Flying Arrow
SHOUJOKAGEKIJUNNA-ARROW.description: Deploys when played and resolves its effect after several turns.
